proposedInterpretationsWithoutSpecificFA: Repeated same-source hits aggregate before the next actual own turn. The first actual Play entry in that turn freezes its unique phase identity, regardless of whether any candidate is eligible. A skipped Play leaves unpaid obligations to expire at that actual turn end.

Only actual HP lost to one is recoverable at the exact paid phase end. Already paid obligations survive source loss, inserted phases and native phase termination by owner death; target death consumes its debt without recovery. No arbitrary turn-end recovery is invented.

Zengdao requires at least one real equipment entity, accepts any available equipment count with native open card bounds, and transfers original equipment into the recipient public pile. The giver source/instance/hash is retained independently of recipient skill ownership.

Exactly one gifted entity is removed for each actual source damage, including self-source and elemental or noncard damage. Multiple available entities across issued grants are a real recipient choice. An ordinary printed candidate cannot duplicate the permanent grant candidate.

Multiple giver grants are distinguished by original giver seat and source instance. One stable grant is only the native mechanism entry; its owning frame retains that entry while a separately selected original grant proves the actual payment.

Successfully issued public gift effects survive donor death/source loss and recipient source loss. Recipient death uses native public-pile cleanup; source-less and delayed-judgment placeholder sources cannot consume a gift.

Multiple distinct giver sources and inserted/skip phases are typed boundaries not separately exercised by these fixtures.
